project_type: FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend, multi-tenant SaaS CRM
build_system: Python venv + pip for backend, npm for frontend. Concurrent dev servers on ports 8000 (backend) and 5173 (frontend).
test_framework: pytest for backend, Jest/Vitest for frontend (if setup). Tests are in backend/tests/.
build_command: Backend: `python -m pytest` (from backend/ directory). Frontend: `npm run build` (from frontend/ directory).
test_command: Backend: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend: `npm test` if configured.
verification_instructions: Start dev servers with `./start-dev.bat` on Windows. Backend health: `curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health`. Frontend: open `http://localhost:5173`. All backend changes must pass pytest; frontend changes must render without TypeScript errors.
environment_constraints: Backend uses Supabase PostgreSQL + Auth. Never commit .env files. LLM provider (Ollama/Grok/Mock) configured via LLM_PROVIDER env var. Frontend must never expose service-role credentials.
contribution_requirements: Read AGENTS.md strictly. All AI-generated configurations must be validated via Pydantic before use. No arbitrary SQL or code execution. Enforce authentication and CRM ownership on every endpoint. Maintain API contract compatibility; update docs/API_CONTRACTS.md with any new endpoints. Every new feature must have tests; run full test suite before claiming completion.
key_patterns: Canonical field representation: CanonicalField (TypeScript interface) = CRMField (Pydantic model). SchemaPreservation and FieldExtractor services already exist and work correctly; they just need to be integrated into the main /generate endpoint (currently missing). RLS policies enforce tenant isolation on crms and records tables. Response envelope: {data: {...}, meta: {request_id: string}}.
directory_structure: Project root: d:\AURA - Copy. Backend: backend/ (app/, tests/, .env). Frontend: frontend/ (src/components, src/features/crms, src/pages). Docs: docs/ (API_CONTRACTS.md, CRM_SCHEMA.json). Supabase config: supabase/. Database schema: schemas in backend/app/schemas/
